positions.title: Senior Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior Lead Software Engineer for JPMC's internal private cloud Kubernetes service offering.

Responsible for working with stakeholders and clients to design and develop applications in the Go programming language to address business needs and ease other JPMC development teams' friction points. Types of applications include Kubernetes Controllers and Operators, Kubernetes Webhooks, and stand-alone binary applications to assist with using the Kubernetes service offering.

positions.title: Cloud Service Reliability Engineer (SRE) - Vice President
positions.description:
Cloud Service Reliability Engineer (Vice President) for JPMC's next generation firmwide strategic private cloud Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) offerings.

Responsible for ensuring the highest level of resiliency, stability, robustness, and security of the microservice architectures that comprise the portfolio of services offered.

Advised senior leadership from past experience operating and managing a firmwide cloud service on implementing best practices and lessons learned, defining Terms of Service, and defining Service Level Objectives (SLOs).

Designed and implemented the 24x7 global follow-the-sun on-call support rotation for the supported services.

Assisted in creating a culture modeled after Google's Site Reliability Engineering role where traditional Operations like work is approached from a software engineer's perspective.

Pioneered the usage of the Go programming language in the team, which is now becoming an official standard language to replace microservice components typically designed with Java.

positions.title: Cloud Service Owner
positions.description:
Service Owner of the Application BackBone (ABB) - JPMC's first firmwide strategic private cloud Platform-as-a-Service.

Responsible for all aspects of the global service including engineering/development and operations/support.

positions.title: Service Engineer / Quality Assurance / IT Support
positions.description:
Service Engineer:
- Provided global on-site training and assistance
- Helped dealers and end-users with questions or issues regarding Eventide's Communications Logging Recorders with a Linux operating system.
- Performed hardware and software service on units sent in for repair

QA Engineer:
- Tested new hardware and software for Eventide's Communications Logging Recorders
- Identified any bugs or unintended behavior
- Documented results and provided feedback for improvements

IT Support:
- Helped upgrade and maintain existing IT infrastructure
- General IT work supporting the employees at Eventide

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description: Linux Grid Computing Engineer at JPMorgan Chase

company.name: Rutgers University - Office of Information Technology

positions.title: Assistant Computer Lab Supervisor
positions.description:
- Highlights
•	Supervisor of the Semester Award (Spring 2010)

- Responsibilities
•	Supervised and evaluated 43 consultants on their technical and customer service skills as well as job performance
•	Supervised the daily operation of the Livingston Campus Computing Center's labs (~125 computers)
•	Account administration and troubleshooting including creation and password resets on UNIX servers
•	Processed applications and conducted interviews for hiring
•	Trained new consultants and Supervisors in Training
•	Created schedules for consultants to keep the lab staffed at all times
•	Responsible for maintaining the Livingston Campus Computing Center's main lab and remote sites, specifically repair and support of lab computers as well as documentation
•	Maintained and updated the Livingston Campus Computing Center's web pages using HTML and PHP
•	Completed daily logs of activities and presented weekly status reports

- Projects
•	Assisted in the testing of the online Hiring Application Tracking System (HATS)
•	Beta tested Google Apps as a viable alternative for project collaboration and communication

- Livingston Campus Computing Center representative on NBCS Committees:
•	2010 Consultant Review , Hiring, and One-on-One Training
•	2009 One-on-One Training
•	2008 Organization Policy

positions.title: Computer Lab Consultant
positions.description:
- Consultant of the Month (February 2007)

- Responsibilities
       •  Assisted lab patrons with PC and Mac networking issues, file storage, printing, and general computer problems
